title: The bay in one stroke
logline: The bay's horizon as one unbroken stroke across the page, edge to edge, and the flats and the sky washed in either side of it. The first page with no drawing in it but a line. The flat stroke of 2014 became a place.

panels.composition: A single unbroken horizontal ink stroke across the page's full width with a gray-green wash below it for the flats and a paler wash above for the sky, nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a single unbroken horizontal ink stroke across the full width of the page with a gray-green wash below for tidal flats and a paler wash above for sky, nothing else, no words
image.notes: The flat_stroke mark (Nov 30–Dec 19 2014) as a horizon.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: One stroke. The 2014 mark as a place.
